glissando.option.background_blur.false.t: The screen will remain sharp and unblurred like for other block GUIs.
glissando.option.background_blur.true.to: Blurs the screen behind the background overlay, making graphical elements pop.
glissando.option.background_bottom_color: The bottom color of the background gradient.
glissando.option.background_top_color.to: The top color of the background gradient.
glissando.option.debug_logging.false.too: Game logs will remain clean and uninformative.
glissando.option.debug_logging.true.tool: Sends information reports about note block behavior to the launcher's game logs.
glissando.option.debug_rendering.false.t: Note block rendering will stay neutral and uninformative.
glissando.option.debug_rendering.true.to: Extra information about note block logic will be displayed visually in the world.
glissando.option.interaction_mode.reclus: Note sounds are played on the client side, synchronizing them better with key presses. Other players will not be able to hear your inputs until the note block is tuned, which will happen when you close the GUI.
glissando.option.interaction_mode.silent: Like reclusive mode, note sounds are played on the client side. However, the note block will be tuned to the new value completely inaudibly when the GUI is closed.
glissando.option.interaction_mode.social: Note sounds are played through the note block, losing some synchronization in favor of allowing other players to hear your inputs.
glissando.option.keyboard_color_conditio: Note keys will always tint based on their pitches.
Note keys will tint based on their pitches but only when they're being pressed.
glissando.option.keyboard_layout.tooltip: The supported computer keyboard layout for Glissando's keybind inputs.
glissando.option.multi_block_instrument_: How frequently note blocks will check their surroundings for valid multi-block instrument formations, in ticks.
glissando.option.open_screen_when_placed: The note block GUI will only open when the note block is clicked.
The note block GUI will automatically open when the note block is placed down.
glissando.option.pulse_animation_time.mu: The length of time the pulsing animation lasts for, in ticks.
glissando.option.pulse_bounce_count.mult: The number of times the note block bounces before settling.
glissando.option.pulse_magnitude.multili: The scale of the pulsing animation.
glissando.option.title_color.tooltip: Whether the screen title text will dynamically tint based on the pitches of the notes you play.
glissando.option.tooltip_line_arrangemen: Which details about the hovered-over note should be displayed on the tooltip and in which order.
glissando.option.tooltip_title_colors.to: The title of the tooltip text will tint based on the pitch of the note you're hovering over.
